subject: Titanic shipwreck
title: The Titanic Was Found During a Secret Navy Hunt for Lost Nuclear Subs

scenes.text: The search for the Titanic was a cover story.
In 1985 the US Navy paid an oceanographer to secretly inspect two sunken nuclear submarines.
His deal: if any time was left over, he could look for the Titanic. He got twelve days.
The subs had taught him a trick. Don't hunt for the hull. Follow the trail of debris.
On September first, more than 12,000 feet down, one of the ship's boilers appeared on the screen.
The world cheered. The real mission stayed secret until 2008.

description:
The search for the Titanic was a cover story.
In 1985 the US Navy funded oceanographer and Navy officer Robert Ballard to survey the wrecks of two lost nuclear submarines, USS Thresher and USS Scorpion. He was allowed to look for the Titanic only if time remained, and he had 12 days left. Using a lesson from the Scorpion, following the debris trail rather than searching for the hull, his team spotted one of the Titanic's boilers just after 1 a.m. on 1 September 1985, under more than 12,400 feet of water about 400 miles off Newfoundland. The Navy link stayed quiet until Ballard described it publicly in 2008.
Did you know the real story? Comment below.
first_comment: With only 12 days left, the team found the wreck in eight. Which other famous discovery has a hidden backstory?
